materials_exhausted.note: Bounded owner-layer rework opened the handoff packet, XML, PDF text, OA-package zip, Supplementary Tables and Figures PDF via pdftotext, and linked DBAASP JSONL rows. No external source was needed.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 rechecked all linked DBAASP assay, experiment, and literature rows against article metadata, Table 1 sequences, main-text MIC summaries, and Supplementary Tables S1-S3. Former source_conflict/database-only rows are resolved as source_verified with notation cautions retained.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 recovered row-level MIC evidence from Supplementary Tables S1-S3, main-text species medians/IQRs, survival Table S4 values, and HAPPENN toxicity scores. No database-only activity row is treated as primary evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 restricts mechanism claims to source-backed computational membrane modeling and unresolved hypotheses; no direct wet-lab membrane mechanism is overclaimed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.adjudication: The blocking ticket rwk-complete-test-0001 is closed after owner-layer source review. Acceptance is accepted_with_cautions because the supplement contains a PEP-137 column-label typo, one DBAASP row uses NA notation for a source-supported resistant/>32 result, and mechanism evidence is computational rather than direct wet-lab mechanism.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework repaired the missing activity/toxicity rows, resolved linked DBAASP rows against primary material, and replaced framework-test adjudication placeholders. The paper is publication-grade accepted_with_cautions with no open rework targets after bounded local recovery.
summary: Owner-layer repair recovered Supplementary Tables S1-S4 activity/efficacy evidence, source-verified linked DBAASP rows, and bounded mechanism claims to computational membrane modeling.

caution_findings.finding: Supplementary Tables S1-S3 label the PEP-137 columns as PEP-138; main text, Table 1, abstract, and DBAASP rows identify the assayed peptide as PEP-137.

DBAASP encodes the PEP-38/P. aeruginosa row with NA concentration/unit, while the primary supplement states R at 32 ug/mL; final activity evidence records this as >32 ug/mL rather than source_conflict.

linked_experiment_records mirrors linked_assay_records for the six DBAASP assay rows; final audit preserves both snapshots with traceability but uses one source-supported activity summary per peptide/species.
Final mechanism claims are restricted to computational membrane modeling and unresolved hypotheses.
The source text gives HAPPENN scores for PEP-137, PEP-136, PEP-36, and PEP-38 and contains a likely PEP-134 typo; no PEP-174 numeric hemolytic-potential score is fabricated.
PEP-36, PEP-136, and PEP-174 are reported qualitatively as inactive in vitro; the local supplement provides per-isolate MIC matrices only for PEP-38 and PEP-137.
